dreamteamer.title: HTML pages
dreamteamer.description: A page on a record. The `html-page` mixin gives a collection one field, `page`: static HTML of 204,800 characters at most, which the desktop app draws in a sandboxed frame where no script runs and nothing is loaded. `dt check` warns about what the frame will not run or load, `dt html` prints those warnings for one record and a page as text, and the `writing-html-pages` skill says how to write one.
